products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters is a publicly traded global content and technology company, listed on both Nasdaq and TSX under the ticker TRI (CIK 0001075124), that describes itself as delivering technology to professionals in the legal, tax, accounting, risk, fraud, and government sectors. The company positions its products around what it calls "Fiduciary-Grade AI," grounding its tools in content from sources such as Westlaw and Practical Law, and emphasizes data governance and domain expertise as differentiators.

The company's primary AI product is CoCounsel, originally associated with Casetext, which integrates legal research, analysis, and drafting and connects with Westlaw. The site describes a customer case in which a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI to increase litigation capacity by 100%. Thomson Reuters also offers ONESOURCE+, described as an AI-powered platform bringing together tax, trade, legal, and risk functions, and a trade compliance tool that automates Harmonized System code classification for import and export. As of August 24, 2026, Thomson Reuters announced the launch of Thomson, described as the company's first proprietary large language model developed in-house.

The held facts show Thomson Reuters maintains a tracked product profile for CoCounsel under the Finance and Legal AI category, with noted considerations around attorney work product risk. No litigation cases or MCP server entries are recorded in the held facts at this time.
